deadline.value: December 1, 2026, 11:59:59 pm Eastern (Graduate School Ph.D. deadline list)
deadline.quote: These are the application deadlines for applicants who wish to begin their graduate studies in fall 2027. | Philosophy 12/15/2026 Physics 12/01/2026 Political Science | For all dates listed, the deadline is 11:59:59 p.m., Eastern Standard Time.

gre_subject.value: Physics GRE optional; may help in some cases
gre_subject.quote: Submission of general and/or Physics subject GRE scores is optional. Applicants who do not submit GRE scores will receive full consideration.

funding.value: Ph.D. students have a five-year guaranteed funding period with 12-month stipends; TA/RA awards include tuition and most fees
funding.quote: all Ph.D. students in their five-year guaranteed funding period will receive 12-month stipends.

also.quote: Tuition ($32,500.00) and most fees are included in the financial assistance award given to TAs and RAs

entry_route.value: A US bachelor's or equivalent is required; holders of non-4-year degrees are advised to get a WES/ECE evaluation of equivalence
entry_route.quote: Applicants must hold either a US bachelor's degree or its equivalent from a regionally accredited institution. | We recommend that candidates who did not receive a 4-year bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university have their credentials evaluated by a third-party service

gre_general.value: General GRE optional; may help in some cases
gre_general.quote: Submission of general and/or Physics subject GRE scores is optional. Applicants who do not submit GRE scores will receive full consideration.

notes: Physics deadline (Dec 1) is earlier than many peers. Duolingo is accepted (125).
